measuredSpectrum.source: HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 8890: 168-1020 nm
measuredSpectrum.note: Space spectrophotometry taken 2001-09-20. The header marks the spectrum good, with a slit offset of 0.815 pixel, under the 0.9 pixel limit for a reliable correction. Polaris is a low-amplitude Cepheid, so the colour is one moment of its 4-day cycle.
